description: Variation of condition 2 of planning permission dated 21st August 2023 (RN 22/04859/FULL) for the Excavation of a basement, erection of rear extension at lower ground floor and lowering of section of rear garden; rear stair garden access and new rear balcony, alterations to the front garden including enlargement and infilling of front lightwelll with glazed pavement light above, raising of front wall and installation of new sliding gate to vehicular entrance, installation of heat pump unit plus changes to windows and doors and internal works. NAMELY, minor increase in basement depth to allow for the incorporation Building Regulation; compliant ceiling void depth (to achieve approved internal floor to ceiling height); Revert the design of the lightwell covering to those approved under Ref. Nos. 21/05522/FULL and 21/05523/LBC. Metal grilles of more traditional design to be installed over both the front and rear lightwells; Installation of underfloor heating at ground floor level (within existing floor void, retaining existing flooring and skirting, with nominal increase in floor height); Damaged walls and ceiling to be repaired using traditional methods in-keeping with the original fabric of the building; Installation of small CCTV cameras on the external façade of the building; Installation of photovoltaic solar panels on the existing roof of the building; and Restoration of the elevations of the building with use of the original finish (non-hydraulic lime render) (Linked to 26/07577/LBC)
